raw_response: In late 2023, Bank of America reported achieving 170 basis points of operating leverage for the full year, attributing this to expense discipline that lowered quarterly expense levels throughout the year. U.S. Bancorp indicated that by the end of the fourth quarter of 2023, it would be on a run rate recognizing $900 million in savings, which was expected to support flat expenses between 2023 and 2024 and contribute to positive operating leverage. Barings (BK) stated its commitment to delivering aggregate positive operating leverage in the following year, citing confidence derived from ongoing investments and platform development. By early 2024, State Street reported generating both positive fee and total operating leverage in the third quarter of that period, noting that this performance was better than expected relative to the same period in 2023.
